makefile_edits: The upstream emscripten platform block only emitted an intermediate LLVM bitcode archive (.bc) with STATIC_LINKING=1. It was replaced to perform the full Emscripten link to snes9x_libretro.js + .wasm with CC=emcc/CXX=em++/LD=em++, STATIC_LINKING=0, and the raw-libretro flag set (ALLOW_TABLE_GROWTH, exported runtime methods incl. addFunction, exported retro_* functions). ERROR_ON_UNDEFINED_SYMBOLS=0 tolerates the core's unused socket/FS syscall references.
verified_with: node tools/core-probe.mjs -> 17/17 raw libretro ABI exports present, Module.addFunction: yes
